title: Bucket Hat
description: A casual round project with a flat crown, steady sides, and a soft brim.
expectationText: A wearable project that practices shaping a flat circle first, then growing smooth sides and a short brim without losing stitch count.

steps.title: Start the crown
steps.instruction: Make a magic ring and place a marker in the first stitch of each round.

steps.title: Round 1
steps.instruction: Work 8 single crochet into the ring.

steps.title: Increase the crown
steps.instruction: Increase evenly each round until the circle reaches the top width you want for the hat.

steps.title: Work the sides
steps.instruction: Single crochet evenly with no increases for several rounds so the hat starts to drop downward.

steps.title: Shape the brim
steps.instruction: Add gentle increases every few stitches to let the brim flare outward.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Try it on, adjust brim depth if needed, then fasten off and weave in ends.
